# Vocabulary

These names are shared by the composer, Settings, setup, status bar and native core dialogs. IDs remain unchanged in commands and storage.

Models use Vibe's reported display name, falling back to the configured alias. Default model applies to new chats. Default thinking level offers Model's own default plus only that model's reported levels. Custom models, levels and profiles retain their configured names.

## Access modes

| ID | Name | Description | Tooltip |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auto-approve` | Full access | Vibe tools run without Vibe's approval card, including outside the folder. Vibe Work's protected actions still need your permission. | Use Full access access mode |
| `smart-approve` | Smart approve | A model checks each tool call: the calls it judges low-risk run, the others ask. | Use Smart approve access mode |
| `accept-edits` | Accept edits | File edits run. Commands and anything outside the folder ask. | Use Accept edits access mode |
| `ask` | Ask | Asks before tool use. | Use Ask access mode |
| `plan` | Plan first | Vibe plans before it changes files. Not read-only: shell commands can still change files. | Use Plan first access mode |
| `vw-plan` | Plan on a page | Plans first and writes the plan as a page in the project's handbook (docs/handbook/plans/). Other file writes are refused; shell commands still run. | Use Plan on a page access mode |
| `explore` | Explore | Explore the project with Vibe's configured profile. | Use Explore access mode |

## Thinking level

| ID | Name | Description | Tooltip |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `off` | off | Turn off the model's optional thinking. | Use off thinking level |
| `low` | low | Use a small thinking budget. | Use low thinking level |
| `medium` | medium | Use a medium thinking budget. | Use medium thinking level |
| `high` | high | Use a large thinking budget. | Use high thinking level |
| `max` | max | Use the model's largest offered thinking budget. | Use max thinking level |

## Vault permissions

| ID | Name | Description | Tooltip |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `askEachTime` | Ask each time | Ask before agent use; commands and sites you already granted remain allowed. | Ask before agent use; commands and sites you already granted remain allowed. |
| `allowed` | Allowed | Standing permission during delegated tasks. Local sign-ins still ask each time; MCP forwarding also needs its server grant. | Standing permission during delegated tasks. Local sign-ins still ask each time; MCP forwarding also needs its server grant. |
| `never` | Never | Refuse agent use. | Refuse agent use. MCP forwarding is blocked while this entry's default or any project refuses. |

## Browser delegation permissions

| ID | Name | Description | Tooltip |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `closeUserTabs` | Close tabs you opened | Choose whether the agent asks before closing a tab you opened or took over. | Ask me requests Close or Keep for each tab you opened or took over. Allow skips that question. The App preview cannot be closed. |
| `closeAsk` | Ask me (default) | Ask before the agent closes a tab you opened or took over. | Ask you to Close or Keep each tab you opened or took over. |
| `closeAllow` | Allow | Let the agent close tabs you opened or took over during your task. | The agent may close tabs you opened or took over during your task without asking again. |

## Agent access and vault lock

| ID | Name | Description | Tooltip |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agentPause` | Pause agent access to secrets | Agent access to secrets is paused. Sessions keep working. | Pause the agent's access to secrets. Sessions keep working. |
| `agentResume` | Resume agent access to secrets | Agent access to secrets is available. Sessions keep working. | Resume the agent's access to secrets. Sessions keep working. |
| `vaultLock` | Lock vault | The vault is locked. Sessions stop until you unlock. | Lock the vault. Sessions stop until you unlock. |
| `vaultUnlock` | Unlock vault | The vault is unlocked. Sessions can work again. | Unlock the vault. Sessions can work again. |
